name: Erasure after three years without engagement: social media intermediary

attrs.quote: Data Fiduciary who is a social media intermediary having not less than two crore registered users in India.
attrs.scope: social media intermediary with at least two crore registered users in India
attrs.note: Third Schedule: three years from the last approach or exercise of rights, or the commencement of the Rules, whichever is latest. Not for access to the user account or to stored virtual tokens.
